title: Director of Business Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: With EFI's massive customer base across sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers (the exact end-users who apply protective films), Business Development owns ecosystem partnerships and channel expansion. Tedlar represents a strategic alliance opportunity where EFI can add value to their 1,000+ customer success employees' interactions without competing with their core printer/ink business. This role would recognize that when EFI customers experience premature graphic failures (fading, cracking, graffiti damage), it reflects poorly on the entire print solution—even if the printer/ink performed well. By establishing Tedlar as a recommended overlaminate partner, Business Development can reduce customer churn, increase wallet share through solution bundling, and create co-marketing opportunities at the ISA Sign Expo, FESPA, and PRINTING United events where EFI already exhibits. The partnership supports their outdoor durability messaging while creating a new revenue stream through referral agreements or value-added reseller arrangements.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As Director of Business Development at EFI, [Name] owns strategic partnerships, channel expansion, and ecosystem development that extends EFI's value proposition beyond their core printer and ink products. This is a revenue-generating role focused on identifying complementary partnerships that increase customer lifetime value, reduce churn, and create competitive differentiation. [Name] likely reports to a Chief Commercial Officer or Chief Revenue Officer and collaborates closely with Product Management, Marketing, and the 1,000+ customer success employees. They have decision authority over partnership agreements, co-marketing initiatives, and channel strategy—but would need executive approval for significant financial commitments. Their scope includes evaluating how adjacent products (like protective films) can strengthen EFI's total solution positioning without cannibalizing core business.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Three Tedlar use cases directly align with [Name]'s partnership objectives: (1) Outdoor signage and billboards—EFI's VUTEk and Pro series printers explicitly target banners, billboards, and building wraps, where Tedlar's 12-20+ year outdoor lifespan and UV protection complement EFI's 'durable Genuine EFI Inks' messaging; (2) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—EFI printers support fleet graphics applications where Tedlar's graffiti resistance (spray paint and permanent markers clean off easily) solves a major pain point for transit authorities and commercial fleets; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps—EFI's superwide roll-to-roll printers serve this market, where Tedlar's weather resistance (-70°F to 230°F, mold/mildew resistant) ensures graphics survive harsh outdoor conditions. For [Name]'s business development goals, these use cases enable EFI to offer customers a validated 'print-to-protection' workflow that reduces warranty claims, extends graphic lifespan, and positions EFI as a complete solution provider rather than just equipment vendor.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name]'s key performance metrics likely include: partnership revenue contribution, customer retention rates (where print failures impact loyalty), wallet share growth through solution bundling, and competitive win rates against HP, Canon, and other wide-format printer manufacturers. They personally care about solving the problem that EFI customers experience graphic failures (premature fading, cracking, graffiti vandalism) that reflect poorly on the entire EFI print solution—even when the printer and ink performed perfectly. This damages EFI's brand promise of 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' and creates churn risk. Tedlar's extreme durability directly addresses this by providing a protective layer that ensures the printed output matches EFI's quality claims for the full graphic lifespan. For [Name], a Tedlar partnership represents a low-risk, high-value opportunity to: reduce customer support burden on the 1,000+ customer success team, create differentiation in competitive evaluations, and generate incremental revenue through referral fees or value-added reseller margins—all without requiring EFI to develop protective film expertise internally.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Three factors make NOW the optimal time for outreach: (1) EFI recently debuted the Pro 30h+ hybrid printer at ISA Sign Expo 2025 and showcased the VUTEk M3h at FESPA Global Print Expo 2025 (May 6-9, Berlin)—these launches create urgency for [Name] to assemble complete solution packages that maximize the new products' outdoor durability positioning; (2) EFI is actively exhibiting at all three major industry trade shows (ISA, FESPA, PRINTING United) where protective film performance is a hot topic among attendees—a Tedlar partnership would provide compelling co-marketing content and booth demonstration opportunities; (3) As a private equity-backed company (acquired by Siris Capital Group in 2019 for $1.7B), EFI faces pressure to grow revenue and EBITDA, making partnerships that increase wallet share and customer retention particularly attractive to leadership. The combination of new product launches, upcoming trade show presence, and PE ownership creates a receptive environment for partnership discussions.

personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging EFI's strong position with customers who need protective films, then position Tedlar as the missing piece that completes their outdoor durability story—frame this as a channel expansion opportunity that strengthens customer relationships rather than a product sale

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI emphasizes 'durable Genuine EFI Inks' and 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' in their marketing, but currently has no protective film component to validate these claims across the full graphic lifespan
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' positioning from recent product launches, then explain how customer graphic failures (even when EFI's printer/ink performed well) undermine this brand promise—position Tedlar as the validation layer that protects their reputation

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI's active presence at ISA Sign Expo 2025 (Pro 30h+ debut), FESPA 2025 (VUTEk M3h showcase), and PRINTING United creates immediate co-marketing opportunities where protective film demonstrations strengthen booth conversations

recommended_approach: Lead with the partnership opportunity angle rather than product specs—emphasize how Tedlar complements EFI's ecosystem without competing, and how it solves the customer churn problem caused by premature graphic failures. Use their recent trade show activity (ISA 2025, FESPA 2025) as a conversation starter to suggest co-marketing pilots. Frame this as a strategic alliance discussion, not a vendor pitch, acknowledging [Name]'s role in building EFI's partner ecosystem.
